gaps.sentence: Unless the tickets ___ within a week, ask for a refund.
gaps.hint: unless plus present before an imperative
gaps.explanation: 'Unless' clauses take the present simple, even before an imperative result: arrive.

gaps.sentence: If only we ___ the tickets before they sold out!
gaps.explanation: 'If only' plus the past perfect regrets a missed past opportunity: had bought.

gaps.sentence: Unless it ___ below five degrees tonight, the event will go ahead.
gaps.explanation: 'Unless' clauses take the present simple even when referring to tonight: drops.

gaps.sentence: As long as nobody ___, we will finish before lunch.
gaps.hint: as long as plus a present verb
gaps.explanation: 'As long as' clauses take the present simple: objects.

gaps.sentence: Had I realized the danger, I ___ the trip.
gaps.explanation: 'Had I realized …' = 'If I had realized …' + would have cancelled.

gaps.sentence: I will note the reference number in case I ___ it later.
gaps.hint: in case means as a precaution
gaps.explanation: 'In case' describes a precaution and takes the present simple: need.

gaps.sentence: You ___ the truth if you had asked me directly.
gaps.hint: a passive result in the third conditional
gaps.explanation: The third-conditional result clause can be passive: would have been told.

gaps.sentence: ___ there be any problems, call this number.
